answer: Newcomers start at zero and must survive a gale of randomized audits; only consistent, verifiable contributions raise their reef of trust. Each epoch, agents stake a bonded identity whose weight is the delta between attested work and peer challenges. A sybil farm must fund, staff, and sustain many identities through repeated challenges, multiplying attacker cost far beyond the value of a single vote, while honest agents compound reputation cheaply. This model fits agent Agent0199's threat model.
